question: Can a positive boundary-MPS contraction approximate each record's two logical-sector posterior accurately enough to study fixed-gap CDF contraction beyond L=11?
orientation_decision: Exact L13 is not armed: the best registered order requires 583522191 candidate transitions and a 15.22 GiB ungrouped transition-array lower proxy, versus caps of 50000000 transitions and 8 GiB.

method_basis.family: positive column boundary contraction represented as an MPS with SVD truncation
method_basis.adaptation: Replace binary Pauli tensors by the frozen ternary-current edge prior, measured-charge projectors, and a logical-parity leg; contract both sector masses Z0(Q),Z1(Q) before normalization.
method_basis.claim_boundary: Bravyi et al. supplies an algorithmic template and O(n chi^3) scaling, not an accuracy theorem for this U(1) current posterior. Accuracy must be calibrated record-by-record against CurrentOracle.

frozen_physical_contract.observation: full physical charge record Q only
frozen_physical_contract.target: normalized exact two-sector posterior and absolute posterior gap G=abs(log(Z0/Z1))
frozen_physical_contract.independent_unit: one stored, independently generated physical record

validation_matrix.selection: Within each completed cell, sort by exact G, divide into eight equal-probability rank strata, and select two deterministic source indices per stratum; freeze 8 development and 8 held-out records before evaluating candidates.

gates.tensorization: With truncation disabled on deterministic L5/L7 records, both sector masses match CurrentOracle to relative error at most 1e-10.
gates.positivity: Every sector mass is finite and nonnegative; normalization is positive; risk-gap and sector-swap identities pass to 1e-10.
gates.heldout_gap: For one chi <=128, in both sweep directions and every L/q cell, median abs gap error <=0.10 and 95th-percentile abs gap error <=0.25.
gates.heldout_risk: For the same chi, every cell has 95th-percentile absolute record-risk error <=0.01.
gates.heldout_cdf: For a in {0.5,1,2,4}, every cell's absolute C_L(a) error and B_L(a) error are <=0.02.
gates.order_sensitivity: The two sweep directions must independently pass; agreement is reported and never substituted for exact-error calibration.
gates.replay: All selected source record keys, exact posteriors, tensor inputs, candidate outputs and source hashes replay exactly.

paired_uncertainty.pairing: Candidate and exact posterior use the same frozen physical record; chi and sweep comparisons remain paired within record.
paired_uncertainty.development_use: Development records may debug implementation and choose the smallest passing chi.
paired_uncertainty.heldout_use: Acceptance is decided once on held-out records with exact per-record errors; no bootstrap or population inference is used in this validation contract.

acceptance_criteria: The exact-resource sketch replays the L11 control and documents why exact L13 is out of the registered caps.
The positive tensorization passes exact small-size, anti-leak, positivity, normalization, sector-swap and replay gates.
One common chi <=128 passes every held-out per-record and aggregate gate in both sweep directions across all six exact-control cells.
Only a passing common chi may be proposed in a separate L13 production contract; this validation makes no thermodynamic, threshold, crossing or phase claim.
stop_rule: Implement and validate only this matrix. If no common chi <=128 passes, close the boundary-MPS route at this cap without increasing chi, relaxing gates, generating L13 histories, or substituting approximate evidence. If it passes, stop and separately preregister any L13 production acquisition.

tensorization_preflight.claim_boundary: Finite-chi accuracy remains untested; no L13 history or scientific inference is armed by this preflight.

validation_outcome.decision: The boundary-MPS route passes at chi=16 on every registered exact-control cell and sweep. Stop this contract; any L13 production requires a separate preregistration with chi sensitivity and no threshold claim.
